scenes.narration: Steve Jobs asked himself one question, every morning.
That one habit made every day count.

scenes.subtitle: Now, your alarm asks you the same question.
You can't snooze this question.
scenes.narration: If today were your last day, what would you want to do? Say it to your own face — it's the only way to stop the alarm.
When you know what today is for, you have a reason to rise — not to snooze.

scenes.subtitle: Morning by morning, your answers become the story of your life.
